correctness.rationale: Every finite meet-semilattice has a least element. The exhaustive procedure considers every relation among the three other elements (64 patterns), checks transitivity/antisymmetry and unique pairwise meets, and deduplicates under all six permutations. It obtains five types. For each, all 4096 possible reflexive binary relations are tested by all meet products and all equivalence conditions. A second meet-closure generation procedure produces exactly the same accepted sets. All sizes, five complete rank profiles, and the rational-distinctness test were independently verified using exact Fraction arithmetic. This is a complete finite proof at size four and does not extrapolate.

value.rationale: This is the complete DSC coefficient spectrum for the smallest semilattice size with five different isomorphism types, not an unmotivated selected example. It distinguishes every type by the coefficient and supplies exact Boolean-diamond and two branching-type counts, plus the full profile by relation size, providing reference data for a problem explicitly raised by Barber and Ruškuc in 2026. Prior chain/flat rows are acknowledged as known. No general higher-order conclusion is claimed.
